description: This Swift source file defines a protocol `MacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices` for services related to screen recording and location services, along with a concrete implementation `LiveMacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices`. The implementation interacts with screen recording and location service components to provide asynchronous screen recording and location data functionalities, with specific focus on macOS.

classes.name: LiveMacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices
classes.description: A concrete class implementing `MacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices`, providing functionalities to record the screen and retrieve location data, executed on the main actor.

methods.name: recordScreen
methods.description: Asynchronously records the screen with specified parameters and returns the path to the saved recording along with audio presence info.

methods.name: locationAuthorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the current location authorization status.

methods.name: locationAccuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the accuracy authorization status for location services.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location with specified accuracy, maximum age, and timeout.
